notes: Transceiver supports 1.25Gb/s to 11.1Gb/s per DESCRIPTION. Rx sensitivity measured at 10.3125b/s with PRBS 231-1 NRZ; Note 3 under ER worst case at 10.3125 Gb/s for BER < 1x10-12. Separate row Rx Sensitivity@10Gb/s (OMA) lists -14.1 without unit in table cell. Dispersion penalty 1 dB listed without paired penalized metric or operating condition. Supply current max 300 mA at VCC +3.13 to +3.47 V (not power in W). DDM temperature monitor range -10 to +80°C differs from operating TOP 0 to +70°C. Storage temperature -40 to +85°C. Optical eye mask IEEE802.3-2005 Compliant.
provenance_datasheet_sections: 10Gb/s SFP+, Hot Pluggable Duplex LC, +3.3V, 1550nm Single Mode, 40 km, EML Optical Transceiver PSFP10-1541SF
suggestions: Add SFP+ to form_factor enum. Consider separate field for rx_sensitivity_oma_dbm for OMA-based sensitivity rows. Dispersion penalty as scalar path/dispersion field when no full penalty tuple is given.
